description: 66 ConnectWise RMM (Asio) partner API operations, plus a local fleet database, patch-compliance rollups, and script runs you can preview, schedule and watch in one command.

novel_features.name: Fleet stale-agent sweep
novel_features.description: Every endpoint across all companies that is offline, missing from the heartbeat, or silent longer than a threshold, sorted by company and silence.

novel_features.name: Per-company patch posture
novel_features.description: Companies ranked by patch risk: endpoints below a compliance bar, missing patches, pending reboots, out of support, stale assessments.

novel_features.name: User-to-endpoint lookup
novel_features.description: Which endpoints a person is logged on to now or was last logged on to, with company and site names.

novel_features.name: Single-endpoint context card
novel_features.description: One card for one endpoint: online or last seen, logged-on users, patch counts, and tickets linked to it or its site.

novel_features.name: Company scorecard
novel_features.description: Per-site health card for one company: endpoint mix, offline count, patch risk and tickets by status.

novel_features.name: Task failure triage
novel_features.description: Failed endpoints from a script run grouped by identical error text, joined to endpoint names, with IDs ready to re-run.

novel_features.name: Reboot triage
novel_features.description: Endpoints with pending reboots split into reboot now, coordinate (user logged on or sessions unknown), offline, and availability unknown.
